description: PQZL proofs (proofSystemId v2, D2) of every statement form, from the C core (pqz_prove, hedged: CTR-PQZ-19), fixed rnd32: deterministic, byte-exact on every build (native = wasm32). statement: the row of that file, under this id. wit: the prover-API witness (pqz.h, R3; not consensus), rebuilt by pqz_kat.py from the seeds. proof_fnv = FNV-1a 32 of the proof. Disclosures: opening = abi.encode(bytes bundle, bytes proof) with the TRANSFER bundle. Validity: pqz-vectors --check (specialised and generic verifier).
